messages.author: Antonio Bauzá
messages.body:
To whom it may concern,
My name is Antonio Bauza from the University of the Balearic Islands (Spain). I am interested in the GPU optimized version of AMBER. Our computers carry the Nvidia Geforce 1660 graphics card, which I have not seen listed in the supported GPUs list. Would it be compatible with AMBER pmemd code like other Nvidia GPUs (e.g. 1060, 1070, etc)?
Thank you in advance,
Antonio.
